# Paris Hilton Wahda Mall

> This Paris Hilton branded store carries the label's fashion, accessories and fragrance lines at Al Wahda Mall in central Abu Dhabi. The mall opened in June 2007 next to Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Street, added a large extension in 2012 and now offers hundreds of stores over four retail levels, together with a hypermarket, cinema and food court. It remains among the capital's most visited shopping centres.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Wahda, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project delivered a Paris Hilton branded store at Al Wahda Mall in Abu Dhabi, one of the capital's established shopping centres. Working for the Khaja Group, MENASCO carried out the fit-out works for the store, completing the installations required for the retail unit to open and operate within the mall.
